title: GEMglIndexMask
description: control the writing of individual bits in the color index buffers

messages.description: bit mask of the color index bits that may be written

arguments.description: bit mask of the color index bits that may be written

body: [GEMglIndexMask] calls glIndexMask() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glIndexMask in the OpenGL reference.
